sourceText:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
University of British Columbia Endowment Lands
2 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in the vicinity of the City of Vancouver, NWD, which is contained within the following described boundaries: All lands within District Lot 140, Group 1, NWD (except thereout Lots 3044, 4804, 4805 and 6494, Group, NWD, and except thereout those portions within the City of Vancouver). The above description includes Lots 3045, 4806, 4807 and 7184, Group, NWD, formerly portions of said Lot 140.
